svg.title: Connected relative-mode positions
svg.desc: A continuous G major fretboard from fret 2 through 15. Five overlapping position contours contain seven relative modal roots. Locrian, position 1, string 6 fret 2; Ionian, position 1, string 6 fret 3; Dorian, position 2, string 6 fret 5; Phrygian, position 3, string 6 fret 7; Lydian, position 3, string 6 fret 8; Mixolydian, position 4, string 6 fret 10; Aeolian, position 5, string 6 fret 12.
svg.text: Parent-major intervals · P1 E-form · P2 D-form · P3 C-form · P4 A-form · P5 G-form · seven modal roots

g.title: Position 1, E-form of the parent-major chord, represented by the Ionian contour
Position 2, D-form of the parent-major chord, represented by the Dorian contour
Position 3, C-form of the parent-major chord, represented by the Phrygian contour
Position 4, A-form of the parent-major chord, represented by the Mixolydian contour
Position 5, G-form of the parent-major chord, represented by the Aeolian contour
